description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the RatingStatistics class in the book project. It verifies functionality such as finding the least and most rated books, calculating average ratings, and handling cases where no such books exist.

classes.name: RatingStatisticsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RatingStatistics, testing functions related to book rating statistics within the project.

methods.name: RatingStatisticsTest
methods.description: Constructor for the test class, injecting dependencies using Spring's @Autowired.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by resetting book data and creating a new RatingStatistics instance before each test.

methods.name: findLowestRatedBookExists
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the book with the lowest rating.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentLowestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies that when no books are rated, the method returns empty.

methods.name: findHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly finds the book with the highest rating.

methods.name: notFindNonExistentHighestRatedBook
methods.description: Verifies that when no books are rated, the method returns empty for highest rating.

methods.name: findAverageRating
methods.description: Verifies correctness of average rating calculation over the set of books.

methods.name: notDivideAverageRatingByZero
methods.description: Ensures that the calculation handles empty data gracefully without division by zero.

methods.name: resetRatingStatistics
methods.description: Utility method to reset the book dataset and rating statistics to simulate empty cases.
